applicabilityBasis.summary: Inherited catalog metadata tracks USDA as a one-dollar, issuer-controlled token, so apparent-payment-stablecoin applicability remains provisional. The October1 recheck of AP U-Card and Alpha Partners documentation does not establish a current USDA-specific fixed-dollar redemption obligation or identify the legal issuer.

genius.notes: The scoped October1 recheck of Alpha Partners documents and the OCC digital-assets application page found no identifiable USDA issuer or token-specific authorization record. Unknown legal identity prevents an exhaustive regulator or enforcement search; no public-action absence is established by this check. Reserve composition, binding holder redemption terms, and monthly independent reconciliation remain undisclosed in the reviewed issuer corpus. Historical metadata, not current USDA issuer documentation, underlies the apparent dollar-payment-token mapping.
